Apple won the ‘Best Picture’ Oscar for CODA back in 2022, and now director Siân Heder is back with another potential winner: Being Heumann. Here’s the new trailer.

Being Heumann gets first trailer ahead of November release

Apple TV just added a lot of classic movies to its library, and the streamer has a packed lineup of original films coming soon too.

One standout title is Being Heumann, from director Siân Heder. Heder’s last project was CODA, which won Best Picture at the Academy Awards. With that win, Apple TV became the first streaming service to win the top Oscar—beating out Netflix.

Being Heumann will stream November 13 on Apple TV following a limited theatrical bow one week prior.

The company clearly hopes for similar success with Being Heumann, and the film’s newly released trailer positions it as an awards contender.

Other noteworthy films coming to Apple TV soon include Ryan Reynolds’ Mayday, which premieres later this week, John Cena’s Matchbox the Movie, fellow Oscar contender Tenzing, and more.

Are you interested in seeing Being Heumann? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV is available for $14.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.
